At the same time, you take responsibility for your own work and are not afraid to ask questions or take initiative when you encounter a problem. Whether you are already experienced in mechanical assembly or are looking to take the next step in your technical career, your motivation and willingness to develop are important. Education and technical experience A vocational qualification (MBO level 3 or 4) or a bachelor's degree in a technical field, such as Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automotive, Aerospace, or a comparable discipline. Hands-on experience in a technical production or service environment. Experience with mechanical assembly, testing, adjustment, and troubleshooting. Good command of English, both written and spoken, for daily communication and documentation. Wat bieden wij je? As an Assembler at ASML, you will work in a unique high-tech environment where you can develop your technical skills and contribute to technology that is used all over the world. You will receive extensive training and guidance and have the opportunity to build a long-term career within an international organization. You can expect: A gross monthly salary of €3,771, excluding shift allowance. 25.1% shift allowance. An additional 0.65% ADV allowance. A 13th-month salary. An end-of-year bonus, based on company results. €0.21 per kilometre travel allowance, starting from 10 km one way. Extensive training and development opportunities. The opportunity to work in a highly advanced and innovative high-tech environment. Be Part of the Impact ASML develops and manufactures the world's most advanced lithography systems. These machines play a crucial role in the production of microchips, which are used in virtually all modern technologies. As an Assembler, you are an essential part of this process. Your craftsmanship, precision, and attention to detail ensure that complex components and systems are assembled correctly and meet ASML's high quality standards. Every component you assemble contributes to a larger system, and every system contributes to the technology that enables the next generation of microchips. Your hands. Your craftsmanship. Your impact on the technology of tomorrow.
